haikus.haiku:
Crimson apples gleam
Crunchy scent fills bright orchard
Taste of summer joy
Happy #NationalAppleBettyDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Chalk dust lifts like mist
Students' eyes glow bright with hope
Lessons bloom in hearts
Happy #WorldTeachersDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Golden candles glow
Breezes carry old soft songs
Joy rings bright in halls
#HappyBirthdayChesterAArthur from @ClamBakeSanta
